build_pipeline: build a FlaxStableDiffusionPipeline from pretrained weights using from_pretrained with bf16 variant and dtype
generate_images: generate images from text prompts using the pipeline call method with prompt_ids params and prng_seed
prepare_inputs: prepare tokenized prompt inputs by calling prepare_inputs with a string or list of prompt strings
run_safety_checker: run the safety checker on generated images to detect NSFW content and replace with black images
unshard_array: unshard a JAX array by reshaping from device batch dimensions to a single flattened batch dimension
